'''2011 German National Championship David Destefanis LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Green Line
* '''Username:''' DDT
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
